name: log4j
description: Apache Log4j across a version x config x app matrix, on real JVMs
writesNote: No verb here writes upstream. `hub` only serves and writes a local page; the one path that can POST is guarded inside hub.py at api_post, which refuses unless the hub was started with --approve-upstream <repo> AND the repository name is retyped for that specific send. Listing `hub` here as a write blocked merely VIEWING the page, which sends nothing.
verbsNote: Reading a pull request or an issue is `oss pr` / `oss issue` -- it needs no clone. What is kept here is what needs this bench: `pr --checkout/--install` fetches the branch and publishes it as a SNAPSHOT, and `followup --since/--write` maintains the review files that live in this repository.
